title: The Switch is OpenPak's home network
body: The Switch is where OpenPak lives today. A retail console creates a profile, links it to an OpenPak account, sees friends and plays online with no Nintendo service and no third-party network in the path. Game servers for sixteen titles are in the programme, the News app you are reading runs on it, and cloud saves are on the bench. If you own a Switch, this is your network — the newest of the five we are building, and the one that already works.
footer: OpenPak — open network services for your console.
